content: Through whatever two collections I have gathered by striving for a long time,Which are as vast as the expanse of space,May I become a sovereign guide and conqueror for all beings,Whose eyes of wisdom are blinded by ignorance.In all my lifetimes until I reach that state,May I be cared for by Mañjughoṣa’s compassion,And having found the supreme path containing the complete stages of the teachings,May I please the Victors through its practice.Using the essential points of the path as I have understood them,And through skillful means impelled by intense compassion,Having dispelled the darkness of the minds of beings,May I uphold the Victor’s teachings for a long time.In those regions where the supreme, precious teaching has not spread,Or where it has spread but then declined,With a mind deeply moved by great compassion,May I make that treasury of benefit and happiness shine forth.Through the wondrous activities of the Victors and their heirs,May the well-accomplished stages of the path to enlightenmentBestow glory upon the minds of those who seek liberation,And may the deeds of the Victors be sustained for a long time.May all humans and non-humans who establish the conducive conditions for the excellent path,And who dispel its obstacles,Never be separated in all their livesFrom the pure path praised by the Victors.Whenever I strive to practice the supreme vehicleIn accordance with the ten Dharma activities,May the powerful ones always grant their assistance,And may an ocean of auspiciousness pervade all directions.This was composed by the Great Je Tsongkhapa.
